correctness.rationale: For octagonal norm N(s,t)=max{|s|,|t|,(|s|+|t|)/sqrt2}, Birkhoff orthogonality has a witnessing supporting functional. Under dihedral symmetry the witness lies between vertical and northeast-diagonal supporting functionals. Boundary witnesses x=(s,1), |s|≤a=√2−1, force horizontal y=±(1,0) and yield d(λ)≥max{1,a+λ/√2,λ−a}, with equality simultaneously for x=(-a,1), y=(1,0). Interior witnesses force x=(a,1), kernel y=(u,-v), u≥v≥0, with u≥1/√2; orthogonality, coordinate, and norming functional of y yield the same three bounds. Hence the continuum identity d8(λ)=max{1,a+λ/√2,λ−a}. Split at 2a and 2√2: on first interval numerator rises; middle derivative has sign (2−√2)λ^(p−1)−1, allowing no interior maximum; last interval derivative negative. Thus μp is max of the two claimed endpoint expressions for all real p≥1, including p=1 and p→∞ limits. Separately computed selected exact λ points and inspected bundled verifier as finite corroboration only.
